facts.text: Brescia University grounds its education in the Brescia Difference, instilling values of Respect for the Sacred, Devotion to Learning, Commitment to Growth in Virtue, and Promotion of Servant Leadership.

sources.quote: As a Catholic university, Brescia is focused on instilling the values of Christ through service and leadership. It is what we call the Brescia Difference:
